subject: [PATCH v8 5/7] mm/memcontrol: move memory stock to page counters

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch moves the memory stock from memcg to page counters, allowing for more efficient and accurate memory management. The change preserves the legacy user-visible relationship between memory and swap usage, even when their raw values temporarily diverge. It also introduces a new logic to prevent reclaiming swap space when both memory and swap have equal limits. The patch removes unused code from memcg and prepares it for future work on introducing additional page counters without breaking the fast path.
